item.title: COP31 climate talks collapse as EU, others reject deal lacking fossil fuel mention
item.description: United Nations climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, collapsed on Sunday after nearly 200 countries failed to reach an agreement, with the European Union and several other nations rejecting a final draft text that omitted any explicit reference to fossil fuels.
